mentions.name: Fit Shapes
mentions.description: This app is a macro tracker focused on removing taps, built for daily use as a cleaner, less tedious, and less expensive alternative to existing macro trackers. Its homepage features a launch video created with AI tools: Claude turning app screens into video, GPT Image for image stills, Fal.ai for animating the stills, and Elleven Labs for music.
mentions.problem: Existing macro trackers are mostly some combination of ugly, tedious, and expensive.
mentions.audience: The author uses it daily; intended as a cleaner, faster alternative to mainstream macro trackers.
mentions.source_excerpt: What might be of interest here is the launch video I made for my app, Fit Shapes—combination of Claude turning the app screens into a video, GPT Image 2.5 for image stills, Fal.ai for animating the stills and Elleven Labs for music.
